name: Shiro to Kuro no Densetsu ~Asuka Hen~
original_name: 白と黒の伝説 ～アスカ編～
source: The final part of the trilogy "Shiro to Kuro no Densetsu" takes us into the 199X-th year. Humanity is on the verge of extinction because of mysterious climate catastrophe. The city lay in ruins, food supplies running out, day temperatures reach +50, and at night drops to -40 degrees. Rumor has it that all of these events are associated with the advent of the demons in our world and are signs of impending apocalypse. Brave group decides to use the last hope and goes into the mountains in search of a mythical temple, which according to legend hid all the answers.
translation: 三部曲《白与黑的传说》最终篇把我们带到199X年。神秘气候灾害让人类濒临灭绝。城市化为废墟，食物储备即将耗尽，白天气温达到50℃，夜间则降至-40℃。传言称，这一切都与恶魔降临人间有关，是末日将至的征兆。一群勇敢的人决定抓住最后希望，前往山中寻找传说中的神殿，据说那里隐藏着所有答案。
